decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to exclude non-speaker items like cases and power adapters. My consideration set focused on highly rated portable speakers across different price points. The JBL Charge 5 was chosen as the final purchase because it has an exceptional 4.8 rating with over 16,000 reviews, indicating high reliability. Its specific features—IP67 waterproofing, 20 hours of playtime, and the ability to act as a power bank—provide the best utility for a portable speaker compared to the more expensive B&O Beosound or the slightly older Bose SoundLink Color II.
